samples.summary: `--scope` is cast, never validated, so any typo silently drops the workspace filter
samples.evidence: `scope: o.scope as TemplateBrowseQuery['scope']` (templates.ts:93) accepts any string, and the very next line gates the workspace on an exact `o.scope === 'workspace'` match. `wafflebase templates list --scope Workspace` (or any typo) therefore sends `?scope=Workspace` with **no** `workspaceId`, and the server's `@IsIn(TEMPLATE_SCOPES)` (packages/backend/src/template/template.dto.ts:138) answers a 400 about `scope` while the omitted `workspaceId` is invisible to the caller. The two conditions (what the union type promises and what the code branches on) can disagree because nothing narrows the flag — commander `.choices(['workspace','public'])` or an explicit check would make the cast honest.

samples.summary: No guard for an unset active workspace: `templates list --scope workspace` and `templates use` send an empty/absent workspace to the server
samples.evidence: `getConfig(opts).workspace` is deliberately `''` when nobody has selected a workspace (see the `workspaceSeg` doc comment, packages/cli/src/client/url.ts:48-66, and `resolveConfig`). In `list` that `''` is then dropped entirely by `templateBrowseParams` (url.ts:133 skips `value === ''`), so the request goes out as `GET /templates?scope=workspace` and the backend answers `BadRequestException('workspaceId is required when scope is "workspace"')` (packages/backend/src/template/template.service.ts:1053-1057). In `use` (templates.ts:183) the same `''` is sent as the body's `workspaceId` and fails `@Length(1,200)` on `UseTemplateDto` (template.dto.ts:283-285). Every other CLI URL puts the workspace through `workspaceSeg`/`seg`, which is where this class of missing-id is normally caught; here nothing local catches it and the user gets a server-side validation error instead of an actionable 'no active workspace' message. Contained (fails loudly, no data harm), but it is a missing guard on a normal-use path (fresh install, `login` with no workspaces).
searchedFor: grep for existing 'no active workspace' style checks in packages/cli/src

samples.summary: `templates publish` parses `--format` after the write, so a bad format discards the publish response (incl. previewToken)
samples.evidence: `parseOutputFormat(opts.format)` runs at templates.ts:159, after `publishTemplate` at :160 would… actually before the call but after the dry-run branch — however for the non-dry-run path the ordering is: build body, (dry-run), parse format, send. That matches the repo's write convention, but note `api-keys create` deliberately parses the format *before* minting (api-keys.ts:38) because the response carries an unrecoverable secret. `publish` returns `previewToken` (registry.ts:1445) and the CLI exposes no `templates get`, so an invalid `--format` after a successful publish throws away the only printed copy of that token; it is recoverable only by re-running `publish` (the service reuses `existing.shareLinkId`, template.service.ts:372-375). Low impact, flagged for completeness.

samples.summary: Design doc still states the CLI has no `templates` namespace
samples.evidence: docs/design/template-gallery.md:983 reads "there is no way to fill it from outside a browser: publishing is JWT-only and the CLI has no `templates` namespace", which this change makes false — `wafflebase templates publish` now exists (publishing remains JWT-only, so only half the sentence still holds). Nothing in CI checks prose, so this will silently rot.

samples.summary: `templates use` cannot target a folder, and `publish` cannot clear description/category
samples.evidence: `UseTemplateDto` accepts an optional `folderId` (packages/backend/src/template/template.dto.ts:287-290) and the service files the copy there (template.service.ts:980-1002); the CLI sends only `{ workspaceId }` (templates.ts:188, http-client.ts:1170-1175), so a copy always lands in the destination root. Likewise `PublishTemplateDto.description`/`category` accept `null` to clear (template.dto.ts:70-84, and the frontend uses it, packages/frontend/src/api/templates.ts:113-120) while `PublishTemplateBody` types them `string | undefined` only, so the CLI can set but never clear a facet. Both are gaps in coverage of the endpoint rather than wrong behavior.
